points.quote: A document is a Yjs CRDT (`Y.Doc`). The block tree is stored in Yjs maps and arrays, and the editor (BlockSuite) reads and writes it directly.
A local edit changes the in-memory `Y.Doc`. ... The editor re-renders from the Yjs change events.
Persisted and transmitted data is binary Yjs data.
Presence (cursors and similar) goes through a separate awareness channel (`frontend/awareness.ts`, `impls/cloud/awareness.ts`).
**Web:** IndexedDB, in a database named `workspace:${id}` ... **Desktop and mobile:** SQLite, through the native Rust module (`impls/sqlite`, `packages/frontend/native`).
`sync/doc/peer.ts` syncs the local storage with each remote peer. ... Local-only workspaces never connect to the server, so they stay on the device.
